answer: Each identity must claim a unique vertex in a shared interaction nebula. Peer attestations or graded jobs create directed edges that three independent established nodes must confirm. Forging a vertex requires posting an umber bond equal to the local cluster’s average edge weight; the bond is jointly slashed with sponsors if a random liveness probe fails. Farms cannot amortize this cost because every fake vertex needs fresh bonds and non-reusable real-time confirmations.
